offer.missing: kubectl is not installed. Sextant can install kubectl {{server}} (the version of this cluster) into its own folder, for its terminals only.
offer.outOfSkew: This kubectl ({{found}}) is too far from the cluster's version {{server}}. Sextant can install kubectl {{server}} into its own folder, for its terminals only.
offer.installed: kubectl {{version}} is installed. New terminals of this cluster use it.

settings.title: Terminal tools
settings.hint: Sextant can install kubectl (for each cluster's version), Helm, k9s and kubectx/kubens into its own folder. They are downloaded from the projects' own release sources and checked against their published checksums, and only Sextant's terminals use them; nothing is installed system-wide.
settings.offerKubectl: Offer kubectl in a cluster's terminal when it has none, or one too far from the cluster's version
settings.kubectlHint: kubectl is installed for a cluster's version, from that cluster's terminal.
settings.failed: The tool could not be installed
settings.unsupported: Sextant offers no tools for this operating system or processor.

helm.installHint: Sextant can install the latest Helm into its own folder and use it when none is installed.
